ai_positioning.summary: Snowflake utilise l'IA dans ses produits et services mais se positionne principalement comme déployeur soumis aux régulations IA émergentes, avec des risques opérationnels et légaux significatifs.

evidence.text: Our generative AI Technology may also generate outputs that are inaccurate, misleading, harmful, offensive, or otherwise flawed... Such outputs may also contain copyrighted or other protected material.
If we cannot use AI Technology or that use is restricted, our business may be less efficient, or we may be at a competitive disadvantage.

Our use of AI Technology or adoption of AI Technology into our products and services may result in disputes with respect to ownership of intellectual property, or exposure to claims of copyright or other intellectual property infringement.
Unauthorized use or misuse of generative AI Technology by our employees or others who have access to our systems may result in disclosure of confidential company and customer data.

Texas' Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act, California's Training Data Transparency Act, Colorado's Artificial Intelligence Act, and South Korea's AI Basic Act impose obligations on developers and deployers of AI systems that may expose us to increased risk of regulatory enforcement.
